description: Show the Sim Farm: how many farm simulators exist, which are awake or in use and by whom, free memory and disk, how many more sims fit, templates, leases, and recent events. Farm sims are slim iOS simulators (about 1.5 GB each instead of 5) that the farm makes from a template. Apps launch as a real phone (an iPhone SE, 2nd gen, by default): they see its RAM and cores and get its memory warnings. Each sim's `phone` shows the app's peak memory, and `overLimit: true` means a real phone would have closed the app. A safety cap closes an app that keeps growing. Start here before sim_farm_acquire. Set `outside` to also list this Mac's other simulators, which the farm never touches.

outside.description: Also list simulators the farm does not own.

name: sim_farm_status
